reviews.text: Brilliant pet shop. Most recent visit we needed a winter coat for our puppy. The girl Holly was superb and patient finding us the perfect one. Good value. They cater for every kind of animal and supporting a local business like this is a must.
A very good place for bird related products.
Great place, well stocked, lovely staff
Thank you Charles, very much appreciated.
Pleasant atmosphere very helpful staff. Always git what I'm looking for

I recently bought my new tortoise from the Clarkston shop along with the full setup, and I honestly couldn’t be happier with the experience. The staff were so helpful, knowledgeable, and genuinely cared about making sure everything was right for both me and my tortoise.

A special thank you to Shannon, who was amazing- she took the time to explain everything clearly and made sure I felt confident bringing him home. You can really tell she cares about the animals and the customers.

Tortellini has settled in so well already, which is a real testament to the advice and setup I got from the shop. I’ll definitely be back and would highly recommend to anyone looking for a pet or supplies!
Thank you Ryan, very much appreciated.

Visited yesterday after losing one of my boys last week to get my surviving boy a pal. I could not be happier with the little socialite I brought home, who managed to settle within two hours and was singing along with my other bird who was in another room (for the mandatory quarantine period)

This little birds loving behaviour reflects in the excellent care it has received from the staff, who clearly care deeply for these animals.

I named her sprite and she's a happy, healthy and confident girl who's happy to stand aside whilst I change her food and water and chats away with me whilst I do so.

I cannot recommend this shop highly enough to anyone looking for a new animal.
